purpose: Extend frozen v5.2 into post-2022 historical windows without changing alpha rules after seeing results.

universe.eligible: NewMarketSegment == Prime Market and ordinary domestic equity
universe.cohort_policy: fixed cohort for all late windows; no later IPO additions; delisted/migrated names retained when data exists

fundamental_source: JPX listed-company service, official TDnet earnings iXBRL links
price_source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance, fetched only after fundamental event table is produced; raw OHLCV, dividends and stock splits
benchmark: 1306.T total-return proxy from same price source
same_day_cutoff_policy: Because the public issuer-detail page exposes disclosure date but not time, disclosures dated on a monthly checkpoint are conservatively excluded from that checkpoint and become usable next month. No same-day release is assumed pre-18:00.

parameters.entry: first available trading-day raw open after checkpoint
parameters.exit: first available trading-day raw open at or after six calendar months; earlier only on fundamental break

corporate_actions: raw shares adjusted forward for stock splits; cash dividends added on ex-dividend/action date supplied by price source
missing_data: No imputation from news/analyst sites. Missing official fundamentals => no score. Missing price => ineligible at that checkpoint and logged.
formal_interpretation: Retrospective fixed-rule walk-forward. These windows are not claimed as pristine human-knowledge OOS because they occur before the strategy was frozen in 2026; algorithmic rules and window boundaries are nevertheless pre-registered before computation.
